purpose: User-selected presets for future PrusaSlicer physical print tests
printer_preset: Original Prusa XL - 5T Input Shaper 0.25 nozzle
profile_policy: Resolve the named installed presets and their inheritance read-only for each new test. Hash the resolved inputs into its output directory. Use Epic FDM PLA on tool 2; do not substitute Generic PLA or an older project snapshot. Saved preset temperatures take precedence over the older experimental 205 C first-layer override.
